newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Airtel to end 1997 with 1.2 mln clients.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Airtel to end 1997 with 1.2 mln clients.

text.p: Spanish mobile phone operator Airtel said on Thursday it currently has more than one million clients and expects to end 1997 with 1.2 million.
Airtel chief executive Ignacio Galan gave the forecast at a shareholders meeting, a spokesman said.
Airtel ended 1997 with a 34.08 billion pesetas loss after 70 billion pesetas in investment and 42.36 billion in turnover.
At the end of 1996, Airtel's clients stood at 652,000 versus as few as 15,000 at the end of 1995.
Airtel is owned by Banco Central Hispano, Banco Santander, Airtouch Communications Inc, Endesa, Union Fenosa and others.
Its competitor Telefonica Moviles, unit of Telefonica has 2.34 million clients at the end of 1996.
